title: What is Famyard Enterprises Ltd
content: Famyard Enterprises Ltd is a real estate company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Nyeri, Kenya, with a second office in Jikaze (Wiyumiririe, along the Nyeri-Nyahururu Highway). It sells value-added plots (land that already has water, electricity and graded roads installed) across Nyeri County, Laikipia County and Nanyuki. It also offers land surveying, conveyancing, land searches, Land Control Board approvals and succession services. Famyard serves local buyers, the middle and upper class, and Kenyans in the diaspora. Its slogan is "Service you deserve, People you trust" and it describes itself as the #1 real estate agency in Central Kenya.
